summary: Agent improperly asked for a PIN (payment/personal data rule violation - major). Agent also did not complete full identity verification before handling a sensitive account request (minor). No other policy violations found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: Do you have your pin number
findings.explanation: The agent asked the customer for their PIN. The policy explicitly forbids asking for or recording PINs or security codes; this is a major violation.

findings.quote: I need your email address. I will send the rest code to your email address
findings.explanation: After the customer requested a two-factor authentication reset (turn 1) and the account was pulled up (system turn 4), the agent asked only for an email address and later a PIN, but did not complete full verification (the policy requires full verification details such as account ID/order ID for sensitive account actions). This is an incomplete verification before a sensitive account action.

findings.quote: Do you have your pin number
findings.explanation: In addition to being disallowed (see personal_data), requesting a PIN is not an acceptable substitute for the required verification fields (full name, account ID and order ID), so verification remains incomplete.
